title: solenandra ixoroides subsp. maestrensis

It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
